result.explanation: A pending offer is a lease: each event first advances time when applicable, then expires an unconnected lease at its deadline. Offers replace all prior state; valid unique approvals accumulate; both parties connect permanently. Matching cancellation clears either session, while stale messages are ignored.
result.mapping: config.ttl and config.parties define lease duration and authorized identities. State stores current time, token, deadline, approvals, connection, and configuration. Each output reflects post-event state plus whether expiration occurred during that event.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated legal contract; unknown or malformed events are treated as ignored without changing state, except that any required expiration still occurs first. Approval output is sorted by Unicode scalar-value order.
